senses.gloss: f. (שָׁקָה, Hif.) giving to drink, esp. (הַשְׁקָיַית סוֹטָה) handing the bitter water to the suspected wife (Num. V, 24).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 2:7">Meg. II, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Megillah 20b:9">20ᵇ</cite>) <he>ולהשקיית וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>ולהַשְׁקוֹת</he>, Ms. L. <he>להַשְׁקָאַת</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:2:3">Y. Sot. III, 18ᵈ</cite> top <he>מחיקה סמוכה לה׳</he> the blotting out must be immediately followed by the giving to drink.
